module: Parses the game's command-line arguments ($Game::argc / $Game::argv0…) and applies or stores the recognized options. Useful to launch BeamNG with -level, -vehicle, -lua, -luafile, etc.
notes: Handled options: -log <0|1|2> (the received mode is shifted by +4 unless 0), -cefdev, -fullscreen, -windowed, -vehicleConfig, -vehicle ($beamngVehicleArgs), -useDefaultPc, -translationScrambleDebug, -luafile (require), -lua (LuaExecuteQueueString), -onLevelLoad_ext, -level ($levelToLoad), -tcom / -tcom-capture (loads tech/techCore; -tcom also opens the server), -levelOffset x y z (server.setLevelOffset), -enableAiRecordingForMissions.
-worldeditor is obsolete: only an error is logged (use -worldEditor).
Simple options are stored in M.args (vehicleConfig, useDefaultPc, translationScrambleDebug, enableAiRecordingForMissions); the others go through VariableRegistry or engine functions.

Bug: in the for loop, "i = i + 1" does not actually skip the next argument in Lua (the loop variable is local to each iteration); the consumed value is therefore re-read as an argument afterwards, with no effect as long as it does not look like an option.
The local functions pushFront/pushBack/popFront are not used.

args.desc: Parsing result: keys vehicleConfig (string), useDefaultPc, translationScrambleDebug, enableAiRecordingForMissions (booleans). Reset to {} on each call of defaultParseArgs.

defaultParseArgs.desc: Resets M.args then goes through all command-line arguments and applies each recognized option.
